d: Back in September, BE:FIRST released the EP WATCH ME, a five-track collection featuring collaborations with Flo Milli and ATL Jacob, among others. The Japanese boy band recently stopped by Genius to perform the hip-hop-flavored title track—which features BIA in its recorded form, and which has nearly 5 million Spotify plays—on Open Mic. The sextet brought lots of energy to our studio and showed why they’re on the verge of an even bigger American breakthrough.
